platform_note: Common Application with Harvard supplement
english_waiver_note: First-year applicants are not required to take an English proficiency exam; tests may be submitted optionally. TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo do not replace SAT/ACT requirement.
aid_note: Same admission and financial aid process regardless of citizenship; financial aid available to international students.

platform_note: MIT first-year application portal (direct)
english_waiver_note: No formal English proficiency test requirement; strongly recommended for some non-native English speakers; no cutoff waiver policy stated.
aid_note: MIT states it meets 100% of demonstrated need for all undergraduate students, including international students.

platform_note: Common Application
english_waiver_note: English proficiency exams are not required; applicants may self-report scores if they wish.
aid_note: Limited aid for international students; applicant must request aid when applying for admission.

platform_note: Common Application with Princeton-specific Questions
english_waiver_note: Required only if English is not native language and applicant attends a school where English is not language of instruction; no minimum scores stated on checked official page.
aid_note: Need-blind for international applicants; meets full demonstrated need with grants; no academic or athletic merit scholarships.

platform_note: UC Application (shared University of California application)
english_waiver_note: English proficiency tests are not required when satisfied through qualifying alternatives, including 3+ years of English language of instruction; exams are one route.
aid_note: International students are ineligible for need-based University gift aid generally, but the university lists institutional scholarships for international undergraduates, including merit and select need-based awards.

platform_note: Common App or QuestBridge application, with Caltech-specific questions
english_waiver_note: Required for international applicants unless native language is English or English is primary language of instruction in secondary school; recommended when English is primary instruction language for non-native speakers.
aid_note: Caltech offers need-based aid to international applicants and states it meets 100% of demonstrated need; international students are need-aware.

Direct online application through ZEuS; restricted programmes may require prior Hochschulstart/DoSV registration.
english_waiver_note: No university-wide IELTS/TOEFL minimum for bachelor applicants established; language proof is programme-specific. Konstanz states no bachelor programmes are currently taught in English.
foundation_year: No institution-run foundation year found on reviewed admissions pages; applicants may need a Studienkolleg depending on qualification recognition.
aid_note: Yes; university lists scholarships for academically strong students and hardship emergency aid; eligibility varies.

platform_note: Direct university application portal for bachelor programmes; international certificates may require uni-assist VPD/grade conversion.
english_waiver_note: International applicants to all bachelor programmes must provide German B1 at application and C1 by enrollment; programme-specific foreign language tests can apply. No universal English test minimum published.
foundation_year: No university foundation programme found; university entrance qualification must be recognized.

platform_note: RPTU application portal; international HZB assessed by RPTU at Kaiserslautern (evaluation fee) or uni-assist at Landau, depending on campus/programme.
foundation_year: Yes if the foreign HZB does not permit direct entry: Studienkolleg / Feststellungsprüfung required; RPTU says the assessment test is not held at RPTU.

platform_note: Direct VIBS portal application; foreign credentials require a uni-assist VPD, which can take 6–8 weeks.
foundation_year: Yes; preparatory college (Studienkolleg) admission route is described for international applicants.
aid_note: Yes; university posts open scholarship calls via International Office news; specific international eligibility varies.

platform_note: Apply through uni-assist for first-year undergraduate international applications; uni-assist forwards assessment to Marburg.
foundation_year: Yes; official deadline page has a Studienkolleg application track (eligibility depends on certificate assessment).
aid_note: No regular bachelor scholarship system for foreign students identified on reviewed university page; programme page states there is no regular system at BA level.

platform_note: Direct application through SNU online application portal (international freshman application).
foundation_year: No foundation route found in the reviewed international freshman information; foreign applicants are assessed on secondary credentials.
aid_note: Yes; SNU lists GKS for international undergraduate applicants, covering tuition, living allowance and airfare; apply through national embassy process.

platform_note: Direct online application through Yonsei Office of Admissions (JinhakApply portal).
foundation_year: No foundation year for 11-year certificates verified; the reviewed international freshman track requires high-school graduation/equivalent, but certificate equivalence is not detailed here.

platform_note: Direct online application via Korea University Office of International Affairs website.
english_waiver_note: Applicants who completed all secondary education in English may submit school transcript and medium-of-instruction confirmation; for Spring 2027 all applicants must meet an accepted proficiency pathway.
foundation_year: No foundation option established in the freshman guide; requires completion of a regular secondary curriculum equivalent to Korean high school.
aid_note: Yes; merit-based international undergraduate awards include full/partial tuition scholarships; selection based on admission evaluation.

platform_note: Direct KAIST international undergraduate online application.
foundation_year: No foundation route identified; high-school graduation by February/August 2027 required for respective entry term.
aid_note: Yes; KAIST scholarship available to international admits, full tuition exemption for 8 semesters, KRW 350,000 monthly living expenses and health insurance; no separate application.

platform_note: SKKU global admissions online portal
english_waiver_note: The 2027 spring international freshmen guide covers language evidence by track; no general IELTS/TOEFL minimum established from the official guide landing page.
aid_note: Yes; 2027 Spring guide revises new-student scholarships; SKKU also lists international merit scholarships (20–50% tuition) and merit/need-based awards for enrolled undergraduates.

platform_note: POSTECH International Undergraduate Admissions application; Spring 2027 international guide publishes direct cycle calendar, but application portal destination is not shown in the reviewed page.
foundation_year: No foundation year identified. International eligibility requires high school graduation; one track requires completion of all 12 years of schooling outside Korea.
aid_note: Yes; all admitted international freshmen receive full tuition waiver; monthly living allowance KRW 500,000, arrival support up to KRW 2,500,000; eligible applicants automatically considered.

platform_note: Direct online application through Hanyang’s Office of International Affairs admissions process.
english_waiver_note: Applicants from countries designated English-speaking by Korea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs are exempt from official English test-score submission for English tracks.

platform_note: Direct online application through Sejong One Stop Service Center (sos.sejong.ac.kr).
foundation_year: No foundation year identified; guide requires at least 12 years of formal education before enrollment, or completed secondary education.
aid_note: Yes; international undergraduate students can receive first-semester tuition reductions of 30–80% depending on category, and TOPIK excellence awards are listed for 2026-2.

platform_note: Direct international admissions via JinhakApply; 2027 spring admissions guide says application opens 12 October 2026.
aid_note: Yes; merit-based international undergraduate scholarships include entrance tuition waivers tied to TOPIK and academic scholarships for continuing students.

platform_note: Undergraduate international admissions are handled by the International Office; application portal and fee were not exposed on the reviewed official page.
aid_note: Yes; latest retrieved international freshman guide shows first-semester tuition waivers of 50% at TOPIK 3, 70% at TOPIK 4, and 100% at TOPIK 5 or above.

platform_note: Direct online application through JinhakApply for international admissions; CBNU publishes separate spring and fall guides.
aid_note: GKS government scholarship route is available to eligible international undergraduates; university-specific aid not established from reviewed guide page.

platform_note: Direct international freshman application through UOS online application link (UwayApply).
aid_note: Yes; official UOS FAQ says international freshman scholarships are selected by admission scores without separate application; top 10% full tuition, next 10% half tuition in guide materials.

platform_note: Direct online application via SeoulTech Office of International Affairs UwayApply application portal.
english_waiver_note: Applicants from countries where English is an official language are exempt from English proficiency requirements for English track.
aid_note: Yes; merit aid includes first-semester tuition reductions based on Korean/English test scores. A separate Key Partner Countries scholarship supports eligible ODA-recipient nationalities; list/eligibility should be checked in current guide.

platform_note: Direct online application through Woosong International Admissions.
aid_note: Yes; first-semester undergraduate admission scholarships usually 30–70% tuition by academic standing, English level and extracurricular record; continuing merit scholarships 30–100%.

platform_note: Direct online application through ITU Registrar’s Office international undergraduate application system.
foundation_year: No 11-year school foundation route established in reviewed pages; applicants need a secondary diploma equivalent to Turkish high school. English preparatory study may be required for language proficiency only.

platform_note: Direct online application via apply.ku.edu.tr (Koç University international undergraduate portal).
aid_note: Yes; 2020–21 university policy described need-based and merit scholarships, considered automatically for merit and combinable up to full tuition. Later 2024 leaflet lists merit awards of 25–100%; no 2027 details located.

platform_note: Direct online application through METU International Students Office application portal.
english_waiver_note: English score is optional at application. At registration, valid TOEFL/PTE or the METU English Proficiency Exam may exempt students from prep; IELTS taken on/after 24 Dec 2022 is not accepted. Native speakers educated in English may receive exemption with approval.
foundation_year: No foundation year for school-certificate equivalence established; a one-year Basic English preparatory programme is available for admitted students who do not meet English placement requirements.
aid_note: Yes; tuition waivers/discounts are awarded annually for academic success; limited need-based meal, dormitory and cash aid is also available to international students by application.

platform_note: Direct international undergraduate application through Boğaziçi candidate admissions portal.
english_waiver_note: Yes; exemption may be available under other criteria, with official exemption confirmation from YADYOK required; details are programme-specific.
foundation_year: No 11-year certificate foundation route found in reviewed admissions source; an English preparatory year is for language proficiency only.

platform_note: Direct online application through Sabancı University International Undergraduate application portal.
foundation_year: No secondary-school foundation for 11-year credentials identified. Sabancı’s Foundation Development Year is the first undergraduate year for common courses and major selection, not an external foundation year.
aid_note: Yes; merit-based tuition waivers for outstanding applicants (25%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 75%); applicants can state scholarship need in application.

platform_note: Direct online application through Bilkent University International Students undergraduate portal.
english_waiver_note: Yes; students may take Bilkent’s own PAE exam at arrival/registration; students not meeting proficiency attend English Prep.
foundation_year: No 11-year certificate preparatory route identified; applicants are assessed through accepted secondary credentials/exams. English preparatory programme is for English proficiency only.
aid_note: Yes; international applicants may receive need-based partial/full tuition waivers (20–100%); continuing merit awards also available.

platform_note: Direct online application through Hacettepe International Student application system; university warns applicants to apply personally and says it has no agency partners.
Direct online application; specific international application portal was not established on the reviewed pages.
foundation_year: No 11-year certificate foundation route established; the FAQ mentions a one-year language preparation class if needed, not academic foundation.
aid_note: Yes; a related BAU incoming-undergraduate FAQ states the listed standard tuition includes a 50% international student scholarship; medicine may receive partial awards. This applies to the source’s international program context.

platform_note: Direct online application through Istinye University international application system.
english_waiver_note: Yes; English-medium high-school graduates with transcript evidence are exempt from English proficiency exam; listed recognized exam scores also exempt.
aid_note: No scholarships or tuition discounts are offered to applicants at admission; after completing one academic year, undergraduates may receive merit scholarships based on GPA and rank.

platform_note: Direct online application through TOBB ETÜ International Student portal.
foundation_year: No academic foundation route identified; English preparatory school is available/required for some programs as language preparation, not 11-year certificate foundation.
aid_note: Yes; merit-only international scholarships with 25%, 50%, 75% or full tuition awards; no need-based aid or extra living/dorm scholarship for international students stated.

platform_note: Online international undergraduate application; official page lists eligibility and required documents but application fee/portal URL was not extracted.
Apply online via Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University’s International Student application system; deadlines are announced per-cycle.
foundation_year: Yes, Turkish language preparatory education is required for students lacking Turkish proficiency; no separate academic foundation year for 11-year certificates established.

platform_note: University’s International Student Office manages admission; current 2026–2027 application portal details not confirmed in reviewed pages.
International applications are submitted under the university’s current international admission procedure; fee, direct portal and deadline not established on the reviewed English page.
Direct application via Universiti Malaya application portal; conventional international undergraduate 2026/27 applications listed 7 September 2026–30 January 2027.
english_waiver_note: English-medium prior education/test alternatives are accepted on a programme-specific basis; see current programme requirements.
foundation_year: UM offers international foundation programmes, but the reviewed materials do not confirm eligibility with an 11-year certificate alone.

platform_note: Direct online application through International@USM / POHON@USM, the USM direct international channel.
english_waiver_note: Candidates from institutions where English is the medium of instruction may submit an authorization letter instead of a test score.

platform_note: Direct UKM online application; international full-time applications are announced annually, typically February–May.
english_waiver_note: Applicants unable to submit required proficiency may take UKM language proficiency courses; requirements vary by programme.

platform_note: Direct online application through UPM international applicant portal.
english_waiver_note: Several equivalent English tests accepted; programme-specific alternatives apply.
foundation_year: UPM advertises an international Foundation Studies programme; its stated entry qualification is O-Level or equivalent, so confirm whether a particular 11-year certificate is accepted.

platform_note: Direct UTM international admissions portal.
english_waiver_note: English requirement may be met after admission within four semesters under the cited faculty page; alternative English qualifications accepted.
foundation_year: Yes; UTM International Undergraduate Foundation/Bridging programme is listed, with separate fees and entry conditions.

platform_note: UCSI direct online application; student visa via EMGS
aid_note: Yes; UCSI lists scholarships for international students; award eligibility and amounts depend on programme and academic record.

platform_note: MSU online application form (apply >=2 months before intake); visa via EMGS
MMU online application; visa via EMGS
english_waiver_note: International students lacking minimum English competency may enroll in MMU English Proficiency Programme; refer to programme-specific test thresholds.
aid_note: Yes; MMU Merit (International) Scholarship is listed for undergraduate international students; 2026 application deadline shown as 2 October 2026.

platform_note: i-ADMISSION UniMAP online portal (i-admission.unimap.edu.my)
english_waiver_note: Applicants below the English requirement must complete the university’s English and Pre-University Preparatory Programme (EPPP).
foundation_year: Yes; UniMAP EPPP lasts six months and is for international applicants needing English preparation; does not establish academic equivalency acceptance for a given certificate.

platform_note: UniKL online application (Apply Now on programme pages)
english_waiver_note: UniKL English Language Intensive Programme is assigned if no English proficiency certificate is provided.
foundation_year: Bachelor entry generally requires 12 years of schooling; 11-year schooling is specified for diploma routes, not a bachelor foundation route.
aid_note: UniKL international booklet reports 50% scholarship for eligible students; current eligibility should be checked with admissions.

platform_note: Direct online application through Tsinghua’s International Student Application System.
english_waiver_note: English native speakers are exempt from the cited English-test submission requirement; language of instruction is programme dependent.
aid_note: Yes; Tsinghua International Undergraduate Freshmen Scholarship (full/half/partial first-year tuition), and Chinese Government Scholarship routes.

platform_note: Direct online application to PKU International Students Division through the applicable undergraduate route (entrance examination or without written examination).
foundation_year: Yes; PKU Yuke/Pre-university provides one to two years of preparatory training for eligible high-school graduates and successful completers may enter undergraduate programmes.
aid_note: Yes; Peking University Scholarship for International Students can cover full/partial tuition, insurance, and living expenses.

platform_note: Direct application via Zhejiang University International Student Application System.
english_waiver_note: Some English-taught programmes waive a separate test for applicants with IB/A-level/international standardized scores or full English-medium high school; programme-specific.
aid_note: Yes; Chinese Government Scholarship (country-specific, Chinese-taught only), Zhejiang Government Scholarship (RMB20,000 for one year, Chinese-taught), and selected English-taught programme scholarships.

platform_note: Direct online application via Fudan International Students Office application system (2027 English-taught guide).
Direct online application through SJTU International Student Center; programme-specific application system and routes.
USTC International Student Application System (isa.ustc.edu.cn)

aid_note: Yes; the same older USTC undergraduate admissions guide says excellent applicants may apply for a USTC Scholarship covering tuition, insurance, monthly RMB2,500 stipend, and dorm fee; current cycle details not found.

aid_note: Yes; Chinese Government Scholarship bilateral / Silk Road Program for Chinese-taught undergraduates, Shanghai Municipal Government Scholarship for Chinese-taught undergraduates, and Tongji International Student Excellence Scholarship for English-taught undergraduates.
